prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready isolated horizontal stone bridge sprite on a genuinely transparent background. Fine varied stone paving, irregular softened chips, believable aged material, slight ochre dust on the walkable central deck. Two low narrow parapets, no tall handrails, no roof, no gate, no people. Grounded square masonry abutments at each end, dark stone sidewall visible slightly below the bottom parapet to show elevation, restrained short transparent cast shadow. A simple low stone arch structure may be visible subtly from bottom edge; never depict a front elevation. Silhouette has real stones and worn edges, not a perfect vector rectangle or rounded capsule. Entire sprite including end abutments fits inside a centered horizontal 3.6:1 bounding box; transparent clear padding around it. Neutral warm gray stone suitable over both a lush creek and an ochre canyon; tiny sparse moss only in joints, not a green bridge. No dirt island, landscape, river, cliffs, lettering, numbers, symbols, ornaments, HUD, border, checkerboard or background fill. It will be scaled to 170x48 game pixels; prioritize readable form and material at that size.
